importantFindings.title: When a docs-only push follows a red or cancelled code push, CI goes green and Pages deploys code that never passed verify:all
importantFindings.evidence: scripts/ci-scope.mjs:27-36 decides from `git diff before..after` of this push alone. .github/workflows/ci.yml cancels superseded runs (concurrency ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress). deploy-pages.yml:36-39 publishes on any successful push run. Probe: `needsBrowser(['docs/working/BACKLOG.md'])` returns false. 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md §6 now says 'release gates and CI: verify:all' and 'GitHub Pages publishes main only after CI passes'.
importantFindings.reproduction: 1) Push commit A to main with a change in src/ that breaks a browser spec; CI for A fails, or is cancelled by step 2. 2) Push commit B that changes only docs/working/BACKLOG.md. ci-scope sees only A..B, so browser=false and the run is `npm run verify`, which passes. 3) deploy-pages builds and publishes B, which contains A's code. Before H1, B's run was verify:all and would have failed. Fix: diff from the last commit whose verify:all passed, or always run verify:all on main.
importantFindings.specRef: 04 H1 item 4 ('the deploy waits for it') and adversarial checklist ('the Pages deploy no longer waiting for CI on main'); 03 §6

importantFindings.title: check:docs' frozen-file rule cannot detect a committed edit, locally or in CI
importantFindings.evidence: scripts/check-docs.mjs:169-176 diffs only `git diff HEAD`. The pre-commit hook runs only check-staged (privacy). verify:quick, required before every checkpoint commit, does not run check:docs. Once an archive, ledger or completed-evidence edit is committed, the next local run and every CI run see an empty diff and print PASS. A green check:docs in CI therefore claims more than it checks.
importantFindings.reproduction: Code path: commit any change to archive/v0.3.0/0_3_0_QUESTIONS.md. check-staged has no frozen rule, and `git diff HEAD -- archive` is then empty, so check-docs reports PASS. Not executed (read-only brief).
importantFindings.specRef: docs/DOCS_SYSTEM.md rule 6 and Enforcement; persona lens 9
